capabilities: match note tags to existing folder names
resolve tags from frontmatter or note content
transform tag names to folder naming styles
exclude folders and route unmatched notes
disambiguation: It does not create folders; it only moves notes between folders that already exist.
extras: The README warns to back up the vault before use, warns that unmatched notes are moved to the vault root, and tells template users to exclude their templates folder; several behaviors (folder creation, unmatched-note handling) are only open GitHub feature requests.
motivation: The author was tired of manually sorting notes through folders and built the plugin to automate that filing.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to file notes into an existing folder hierarchy based on their tags, so users sort notes manually.
summary: Rule-based distributor that automatically moves notes into existing folders by matching the tags in each note to folder names.
